The employer annual report https://www.leibniz-inm.de/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Jahresbericht-2023.pdf (printed p. 38) documents a 2020 biology doctorate, a subsequent postdoc, and leadership of the INM microscopy service group since 2023; together these establish an enduring career research appointment in Saarbruecken, Germany. The individual alumni biography https://www.uni-muenster.de/CiM-IMPRS/students/alumni/duong_cao_nguyen.html explicitly gives Thanhhoa, Vietnam as his origin and matches the biology/Muenster training. Independently ran find-roster-matches with the name, employer profile, linked ORCID, and alumni biography. Hits vp-0023 and vp-0358 are different people: roster records identify electrical/computer-engineering academics with Michigan State University (2021) and University of British Columbia (2020) doctorates respectively, distinct from this molecular-biomedicine/microscopy researcher. No matching name in already-proposed.txt.
